t: This is Stratford Place, a small cul-de-sac running off Oxford Street, opposite Bond Street underground station. It's a quiet pocket tucked away from the crowds just beside it. One person tied to the street is Juliana Colyear, Countess of Portmore, who died here in 1794. She was an English noblewoman and philanthropist, the third wife of the Duke of Leeds, and later married the Earl of Portmore. Her son went on to become the third Earl.
